- [USER] User asked for examples of specific environmental policies that Canada has implemented to promote sustainability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Canada has implemented carbon pricing under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act to encourage reduction of greenhouse gas emissions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Canada has banned single-use plastics, including straws, cutlery, and bags, to reduce plastic pollution and encourage sustainable alternatives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Canada has set a target of net-zero emissions by 2050 and aims for 90% of its electricity to come from non-emitting sources by 2030.
